description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies a method for logging messages with various levels of detail and optional exception information. It is part of a logging system designed to enable flexible and chainable log handlers within an Android application.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for log nodes in a chain, responsible for outputting log data and passing it along to the next node in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception.
